en.description:
Important Note: This app can only be downloaded from the App Store on Apple Watch. Here's how:
1. Press the Digital Crown on your watch to open the app list
2. Find and open the App Store
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap [Account]
4. Find [Purchased] to download the app


Block Blast: A perfect mix of block puzzle and jigsaw puzzle games, combining creativity with the classics!
With simple controls, wonderful sound effects, and a great rhythm, Block Blast will leave you wanting more! The perfect app on your wrist to kill time and relax!
Block Puzzle Game Features:
Simple and easy to play, an excellent choice to kill time.
No WIFI or internet connection is needed, you can enjoy the block puzzle game anytime, anywhere.
How to Play Block Puzzle Games:
Drag and drop the blocks onto the board and clear the blocks when a column or row is filled.
We will continuously provide blocks of various shapes until there is no remaining space on the board.
Plan your next move as you think about what blocks might show up.
No matter where you are, whether you’re tired, bored, or frustrated, this block puzzle game will always be by your side to sweep away boredom and help you relax and cheer up!
Suggestions or Comments? Give us a shout at i@ztyuu.com
en.subtitle: Block Puzzle for Watch
